name: Priya M.
reviewText: The Oslo sofa transformed our living room completely. The quality of the sheesham wood and upholstery is genuinely premium — our guests always ask where we got it from.

name: Rahul K.
reviewText: Delivered in 4 days to Hyderabad and assembled within the hour. The solid sheesham wood is exactly as described — rich, sturdy and beautifully finished.

name: Ananya S.
reviewText: Finally furniture that fits a modern 2BHK properly without looking bulky. The dimensions were 100% accurate and customer support on WhatsApp answered every single query.
